anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, confidence, or opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
No active or closed trades and zero total profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform with active strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Enhance AI model training and opportunity generation to improve trading decision-making and profitability.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Review and troubleshoot AI system functionality to ensure it is generating learning cycles and opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can hinder the platform's ability to make informed trading decisions, impacting profitability.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the trading strategies and system configuration to identify why no trades are being executed.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring active trading is crucial for platform revenue and user engagement.
